reviews.comment:
Tanto el taller como boxes un desastre, tenía las gomas delanteras gastadas en el parche de contacto interior y no fueron capaz de avisarme y el informe me las dieron como buenas... Hice boxes hace dos meses atrás en esta estación y pague $175.999, ayer hice el mismo servicio en ACA central y pague $148.568 , dos meses después me salió más barato.... Raro no???? Y los controles que dicen hacer en boxes por lo menos de esta estación son cuestionables. No me crees, al salir agarra el informe y verifica paso por paso y te darás cuenta vos mismo que son un desastre. Y si captan de ser la mejor estación de servicio y la más premiada y con mejores calificaciones... Vergüenza dan!!!

(Translated by Google)
Both the workshop and the service bays were a disaster. My front tires were worn on the inner contact patch, and they didn't even bother to warn me, yet they marked them as good on the service report. I had my service done at this station two months ago and paid $175,999. Yesterday, I had the same service done at the main ACA station and paid $148,568. Two months later, it was cheaper... Strange, isn't it? And the inspections they claim to do in the service bays, at least at this station, are questionable. Don't believe me? Grab the report when you leave and check it step by step, and you'll see for yourself what a disaster they are. And if they think they're the best service station, the most awarded, and the highest-rated... They're a disgrace!

reviews.comment:
Mi reseña es en relación a la Oficina del ACA para sacar el Registro Internacional. La atención de las empleadas deja mucho que desear, son ¨secas¨, no te dicen los requisitos para obtener el mismo ya que argumentan que están en la web del ACA. Evidentemente estas personas nunca han hecho un tramite o se han presentado a realizar un estudio medico y les ha faltado algun detalle. No tienen afinidad para tratar a las personas.

(Translated by Google)
My review concerns the ACA office for obtaining an International Driver's License. The staff's service leaves much to be desired; they are unprofessional and don't explain the requirements, claiming they are available on the ACA website. Clearly, these people have never completed a procedure or undergone a medical examination themselves and have overlooked some detail. They lack interpersonal skills.

Le recuerdo a esta señora que el sueldo y su puesto de trabajo lo tiene gracias a todos nosotros, los clientes.
Las autoridades de ACA deben controlar el trato que se le brinda a los clientes y despedir a este tipo de empleados maleducados. Hay muchas personas educadas que van a querer ocupar ese lugar con responsabilidad.

(Translated by Google)
Honestly, I'm leaving feeling very distressed and disappointed by the terrible customer service. I'm particularly shocked that the employee, being quite elderly, was so rude. Respect and courtesy should always come first.

ACA management needs to monitor how customers are treated and fire these kinds of rude employees. There are plenty of polite people who would be happy to fill that position responsibly.
